title: The Album
scene: Swedish international pop-rock; concept-like theatrical sequences
notes: Ambitious pop-rock, progressive arrangements and three theatrical songs from a miniature stage musical.

title: Voulez-Vous
scene: Swedish disco-era Europop; Stockholm and Miami recording
notes: Disco-heavy productions alternate with reflective Europop ballads and occasional guitar-led rock.

title: Super Trouper
scene: Mature Swedish Europop and early synth-oriented dance-pop
notes: Bittersweet adult pop, heartbreak ballads, synthesizer experiments and a few vibrant dance tracks.
